scope: Exploratory P2 dynamic map geometry and publication-time verification for one simulated D435i/VINS/plan_env run
qualification: This is descriptive evidence only. It does not pass P2, P4, GOAL.md B/C/D/E, planner behavior, or flight acceptance.

environment.ego_source_revision: ZJU-FAST-Lab/ego-planner-swarm ros2_version 23a8d5a191711dd65633df689bd00f55d4dea8f9 plus project patches through 0005
environment.truth_isolation: Gazebo truth is recorded only by the debug motion tool for offline evaluation; VINS, localization adapter, mapping adapter, depth gate, and plan_env receive no truth pose or complete world map.
environment.control_scope: No PX4, control bridge, or vehicle control publisher was started.

patch_effects: Both plan_env occupancy PointCloud2 outputs receive a ROS-clock publication stamp.
EGO advanced_param.launch.py sets use_sim_time=true so node_->now() uses the Gazebo /clock in this simulation launch.
implementation.patch_application_check: Applied to a reconstructed post-0004 source tree; both changed EGO files compared byte-for-byte.

localization_discovery_fix.behavior: Jazzy unknown publisher node-name/namespace sentinels are treated as unresolved metadata and retried; the adapter binds only after identity is available, while actual identity changes still lock the epoch.
localization_discovery_fix.trigger: Run 07 logged expected (_NODE_NAME_UNKNOWN_, _NODE_NAMESPACE_UNKNOWN_) followed by the real vins_estimator identity; earlier run 05 locked on that discovery transition.

localization_health_tests.result: 9 tests passed, including unresolved DDS identity sentinels.

build_and_unit_checks.python_compile: Passed for localization health/node/tests and the offline map geometry evaluator.

excluded_diagnostic_attempts.reason: The adapter bound Jazzy temporary _NODE_NAME_UNKNOWN_ / _NODE_NAMESPACE_UNKNOWN_ endpoint metadata, then locked when the same publisher resolved as vins_estimator.

excluded_diagnostic_attempts.finding: At inspection time all three VINS output topics had one publisher with node vins_estimator in the session namespace; the adapter had already locked on an earlier unresolved identity.
The added log captured the temporary unknown identity and later resolved identity, confirming the discovery race; no geometry result was taken from this run.

excluded_diagnostic_attempts.reason: Jazzy rclcpp::Time has no to_msg(); patch now writes sec/nanosec from nanoseconds().

runtime_probe.mapping_adapter_reset_ack: Confirmed in mapping-adapter.log before accepting mapping input.

map_publication_time.note: This verifies a nonzero stamp on the same simulation time line; map update latency was not measured.

trajectory_evaluation.alignment: Single SE(3), scale fixed to 1, no segment realignment

map_geometry.alignment: Single SE(3), scale fixed to 1, no segment realignment

dynamic_run.planner_status: EGO stayed in INIT and logged no odom; no goal was sent and no planner response is demonstrated.
dynamic_run.shutdown: Run container exited and was removed; no Python traceback or process-has-died message was found. EGO emitted its existing odom/depth timeout log after its final occupancy update; clean planner shutdown and fault behavior remain unqualified.

limitations: The only alignment is the single rigid SE(3) trajectory alignment; map points do not influence the alignment.
The probe selects the largest occupancy PointCloud2 observed during one run, not a persistent map snapshot.
This compares distance to the two x faces of one planar wall and does not score coverage, unknown/free classification, inflation, obstacle clearance, or planner response.
The publication stamp is checked against the recorded simulation clock and optimized odometry time range; mapping latency is not separately measured.
No acceptance thresholds are frozen; these values are descriptive only.
The dynamic occupancy cloud is a probe-selected maximum published cloud, not a persistent or replayed map snapshot.
Only one planar calibration wall and one motion profile were assessed; repeated cold starts, other obstacles, map ghosts, unknown/free classification, inflation, and clearance are not evaluated.
EGO did not receive the expected localization odometry topic and remained INIT; planning behavior is not qualified.
No controlled depth stale injection, epoch reset test, clock regression, PX4 EKF2 fusion, flight control, or ten-minute run occurred.
Health and mapping thresholds remain PROVISIONAL; the geometry statistics are descriptive and no acceptance thresholds are frozen.
